# Vetlas

Indore-first veterinary directory. Public-source research, not medical advice or independent verification of medical quality. Provider facts checked 2026-11-15. Confirm current fees and availability directly.

- [Indore directory](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/indore/)
- [Public dataset with evidence links](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/directory.json)
- [Consultation fee comparison](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/costs/)
- [Methodology](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/methodology/)

Eight researched facilities are currently included. No first-party reviews have been published. Reddit discussions are anecdotal and may refer to other branches. Two Royal branch coordinates come from their website; other map links are searches/area previews. Coordinates are not independently confirmed. Platform rating means use available sourced scores with equal weight, one value per platform, never pooled review counts. Coverage is incomplete; snapshots may be old and Justdial may overlap with other platforms. Google Places media and live scores require setup and are not included in the static dataset. Dr. Nigam fee sources conflict. Dogsvilla's fee is a starting figure. Missing costs are unknown, never zero. Small selected-list means are not city-wide averages.
